en.topic_title: Cold front to bring 15°C lows to Hong Kong on Friday, rain next week
en.topic_summary:
Hongkongers will experience another cold snap towards the weekend, with the Observatory predicting lows of 15 degrees Celsius this Friday.



File Photo: GovHK.



The weather service expects lows of 18 degrees Celsius on Thursday, with temperatures on Friday ranging from 15 to 18 degrees Celsius.
